description: Build text-only scene context for a short request and optional visual preference, for use in the caller's own image-capable assistant. The endpoint receives no image and generates no image. No authentication required. A request containing an image is rejected; keep any photograph in the originating assistant. Use get_cassie_hour_visual_canon for general reference.

language.description: Optional output language tag, up to 16 characters; defaults to en.

request_text.description: Required text request for a scene context, 1–240 characters; do not include or attach a photograph.

scene_preference.description: Optional text-only visual preference, up to 240 characters.

name: put_me_inside_cassie_hour
title: Build a Cassie Hour scene prompt
